title: Pure Nemleria
summary: Nemleria cards only, with generic Rank 10s and staples. Nemleria spends its Extra Deck: the Level 10 Beasts and Spells banish face-down Extra Deck cards as their cost. Once only Dreaming Nemleria is left in the Extra Deck, it summons itself and banishes their cards for every three you banished. Dreaming Nemleria starts it all from the Pendulum Zone. It places Dream Tower of Princess Nemleria from the Deck and goes face-up into the Extra Deck, which lets Couette and Oreiller summon themselves from the hand. Dream Tower searches two Level 10 Beasts. Nemleria Dream Devourer - Reveil and Dreaming Reality of Nemleria, Realized, the newest monsters, summon themselves, Set a Nemleria Trap and flip a monster face-down. Nemleria Repeter negates their whole board. The Extra Deck is mostly fuel, plus a few Rank 10s for the Level 10 Beasts.
